snippet.title: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe
snippet.description: Papa's Pizzeria Deluxe is coming soon to Steam, where you’ll be choosing dough, piling on toppings, and serving up piping hot pizzas in this freshly remastered edition! Dive back into the pizza-making mayhem on your PC, complete with brand-new graphics and exciting twists that you are sure to love. This fully revamped version of Papa's Pizzeria packs in all the latest features from our mobile games, like Special Recipes, Score Details, and custom Drivers to handle those delivery orders. The kitchen isn’t the only place heating up – the Pizzeria has a new Food Truck ready to hit the streets! Get creative in free-play mode, mix and match ingredients, and serve up your wildest pizza inventions to see who stops by for a slice. Whether you're making fan-favorite classics or quirky new pies, the possibilities are endless!
